persona: Mairi from Inverness works as a Route Manager for the North Coast 500 tourism collective. She coordinates with Highland Council rangers and local estates to manage visitor pressure, dirty camping, single-track roads, passing places, and local concerns during the tourist season.
task: Draft a concise NC500 Ranger Notice for Highland Council rangers, using only the passing-place and dirty-camping safety lines and leaving out café, ferry, and tourist-service details.
